en.askTitle: Enter your own target income, costs and client brief, and get a day rate and a three-tier proposal you can check
en.runTitle: A Glasgow designer going freelance: day rate, fixed price and contract for a whisky start-up

fields.label: Client and brief
fields.value: A small Scottish whisky start-up: brand identity with logo, palette, type, a simple brand guidelines PDF and 10 social templates

fields.label: Actual annual costs
fields.placeholder: e.g. £6,000 a year for software, equipment, insurance and an accountant

fields.label: Realistic billable days
fields.placeholder: e.g. 155 billable days a year after holidays, admin and sick days

fields.label: Tax residence, other income and start date
fields.value: Glasgow, going freelance as a sole trader in January 2027

fields.label: Client budget
fields.placeholder: e.g. the client has said around £5,000

en.template: Help me plan a sustainable design rate and a three-tier proposal for {client}. Use {target}, {costs}, {days}, {tax} and {budget}. Define deliverables, editing tools, sizes, revisions, payment milestones and usage rights. Mark tax rules and contract terms that need professional checking. Prepare a draft for me to review; do not send it, contact the client or commit me to anything.

phases.title: Check tax, filing and insurance rules and published UK design day rates
phases.note: HMRC and Scottish tax rules, filing deadlines, insurance examples and rate surveys
phases.judgment: It would not state a rule that did not exist yet. The Scottish income tax bands for 2027/28 could not be found, so they were marked unconfirmed (the Scottish Budget was scheduled for 3 December 2026) and the calculation uses 2026/27. It also noted the new trade may only enter Making Tax Digital in April 2028, not automatically in April 2027.

phases.title: Build the pricing guide, contract template and day-rate calculator
phases.note: Day rate, three-tier proposal, contract checklist, Word template and Excel calculator
phases.judgment: The guide says what its numbers rest on: £6,000 of annual costs, 155 billable days and 2026/27 Scottish tax give a target-covering rate of £326.90, so it proposes £350 a day. It also warns that prior employment income means the January–April 2027 tax bill needs a separate calculation.

phases.title: Independent check of the arithmetic, the workbook and the documents
phases.judgment: A separate colleague found a real error in the calculator: the 48% tax band started at £112,570 instead of £125,140, overstating tax by £377.10 at the top of that range. The threshold was corrected in all 63 tax formulas and re-checked.

workers: Found current published UK freelance design day-rate surveys and insurance price examples, with dates
Read official rules on Self Assessment deadlines, VAT, Making Tax Digital, late-payment interest and copyright ownership
Recomputed the tax and pricing figures independently and reviewed the contract template and workbook for mistakes
